core_obligations: Identify the supported subsheaf after pushforward (proof lines 8922-8928).
Use exactness of g'_* to conclude (proof lines 8928-8931).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a blowup S' -> S in a closed subscheme Z, an affine morphism g : X -> Y over S with base change g' and a quasi-coherent F on X with strict transform F', the pushforward g'_*(F') is the strict transform of g_*(F) (source lines 8908-8918). The proof first observes that g'_* of the pullback of F is the pullback of g_*F by the affine base change formula, then lets K be the subsheaf of sections supported in the inverse image of Z and uses the pushforward-of-supported-sections lemma to identify g'_*K with the corresponding subsheaf of pr_Y^*g_*F, and concludes because g' is affine and hence g'_* is exact.
